name: Masyanya Under The Yellow Press
storyline: Masyanya decided to try her hand at journalism: now she is a reporter for a tabloid newspaper. In this online game you will meet a lot of hilarious characters, as well as old friends of the virtual young lady-Hrundel and Shaggy. Add to this the signature sound of Masjani's voice, and you'll get a cocktail of jokes and laughs that you won't find anywhere else. As a result, here is a fun and fun adventure in the genre of quest with Masyanya in the title role.
summary:
The game is a typical quest from Alawar. It was released on October 22, 2008.

The game features an interface that includes a bar with collectible items, an inventory, a task list, a score multiplier gauge, a Masyanya icon, and a hint button. If you click incorrectly for too long, the multiplier will reset, and Masyanya will get sad.

Collectible items can sometimes automatically combine. The game also includes close-up views and mini-games displayed in separate windows.
